hems.definition:
n the edge of a piece of cloth; especially the finished edge that has been doubled under and stitched down
n the utterance of a sound similar to clearing the throat; intended to get attention, express hesitancy, fill a pause, hide embarrassment, warn a friend, etc.
v fold over and sew together to provide with a hem
v utter `hem' or `ahem'
hems.translation:
n. 布的褶边, 贴边( hem的名词复数 ); 短促的咳嗽
v. 缝…的褶边( hem的第三人称单数 ); 包围

hemsley.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 赫姆斯利住所名称，来源于古英语人名Helm+“树林，开垦地”(wood,clearing)，或人名Hemele+“岛”(island)

hemsmeba.translation: [医] 血变形虫目, 血孢子虫目

hemstitch.definition:
n. a stitch in which parallel threads are drawn and exposed threads are caught together in groups
n. embroidery similar to drawnwork
v. sew with hemstitches
hemstitch.translation:
n. 抽丝线迹
vt. 用抽丝法做花边

hemstitch suture.translation: [医] 衣缘缝术, 花边缝术

hemstitched.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Hemstitch
a. Having a broad hem separated from the body of the
   article by a line of open work; as, a hemistitched handkerchief.
hemstitched.translation: v. 抽丝做花边, 结垂迹( hemstitch的过去式和过去分词 )

hemstitcher.translation: 缝纫机上用于抽绣的附加装置

hemstitches.definition:
n a stitch in which parallel threads are drawn and exposed threads are caught together in groups
n embroidery similar to drawnwork
v sew with hemstitches
hemstitches.translation: n. 抽丝做成的花边饰, 垂迹( hemstitch的名词复数 )

hemstitching.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Hemstitch
hemstitching.translation: v. 抽丝做花边, 结垂迹( hemstitch的现在分词 )

hemsworth.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 赫姆斯沃思住所名称，来源于古英语人名Hymel+“圈用地”enelosure); [地名] [英国] 赫姆斯沃思
